changes: Reduced GPU memory use by leaving unused vision components unloaded during text translation, while retaining the same text model and 2,048-token context.
Existing installations automatically upgrade the verified local backend without changing downloaded models or preferences.
Incoming translations display sooner and use fewer LLM calls: source-language detection now runs when you select Reply instead of delaying every incoming message.
Reorganized client Settings into Translation, Overlay and Window groups with consistent spacing and a clearer reading order.
Removed the movement, immediate-save and system-notice explanatory text from overlay Settings.
Improved the reported Greeklish clan-war sentence while keeping who is being addressed and leaving its omitted final action unstated.
Added contextual help for the reported Greeklish poll, retaining names, stated ages, alternatives and crude wording. Its ambiguous ending uses a literal reading.
Improved the reported Greeklish football-fan insult, preserving the plural profanity and Panathinaikos reference.
Updates started from this version show a responsive progress window for file checks, backups, installation, verification, recovery and full-installer fallback downloads.
Moved the Show overlay checkbox into the client Settings and removed it from overlay settings.
Removed the Overlay settings button from the client. Open overlay settings from the overlay.
Opening the translator again brings the running window to the front instead of showing an already-open error. This also restores windows minimized to the taskbar or hidden in the system tray.
Repeated launches keep the existing translation session. During shutdown, opening the translator again shows its Closing window.
Moved the overlay lock control to the main window's Settings. Lock or unlock it there even when the overlay ignores mouse clicks or starts locked from saved preferences.
Removed the Lock button and lock checkbox from the overlay so its controls cannot lock themselves out.
Removed Translate recent chat and simplified the main toolbar. The translator continues reading new chat as it appears.
Future updates download only changed or missing application files, with signed verification and a full installer fallback when needed.
File updates keep recovery backups, verify the installed files and roll back failed updates. Models and settings stay preserved.
Overlay Settings now opens as an attached animated drawer, matching Channels. Switching between them finishes the current drawer's closing animation before opening the other.
The Settings drawer follows the overlay's position and width, with wrapped controls and scrolling to keep settings reachable on smaller screens.
Added an optional Close to system tray setting. Closing the window keeps translation and the overlay running; right-click the tray icon and choose Exit to quit.
Exiting from the tray brings the main window back with closing progress until shutdown finishes. Minimize to system tray remains a separate setting.
Extended Greeklish 'good evening to all' greetings to supported group messages, including 'ektos apo ton' ('except') endings with one- or two-word person labels.
Improved short Greeklish kalhspera/kalispera greetings, including uppercase messages, so they translate as 'Good evening'.
Kept paidia plural in supported short greetings ('guys' or 'kids'), while retaining normal handling of names and singular forms.
Preserved repeated ASCII-art decorations such as ',i, ,i, ,i,' in translated messages instead of dropping or rewriting them.
Decorations framing a message stay on their original side while the complete text between them is translated.
Linked items now appear in light grey and party recruitment links in light blue in the launcher and overlay.
Surrounding text and player names keep their chat-channel colors. Party descriptions remain translated, and original-message views use the same link colors.
Improved standalone Spanish approval replies such as 'bien ahÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â­' so they read naturally in English ('Nice!').
Added selected English farm/farming game vocabulary for Spanish replies, using farmear/farmeando in supported activity and verb contexts while retaining the original grammar and stated details.
Matched Shout chat and its channel labels to the in-game orange color.
Improved English translations of Greeklish 'afou to lete kai oi dyo/dio' endings ('since both of you say so'), including uppercase text. The similar 'to lene' form retains 'both of them'.
This improvement applies to complete say-so clauses at the end of a message. Other Greeklish phrases can still be mistranslated.

Added interface translations for English, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Polish, German, French, Turkish, Korean, Japanese and Simplified Chinese across the installer, launcher and chat overlay.

Choose your language before the installer begins. A language selector stays visible at the top of the launcher; changes apply immediately to the launcher and overlay and are remembered for future launches.
Interface language is separate from the chat translation target. Changing menus does not change translated chat or reply content.
Matched Whisper chat and its filter labels to the in-game bright magenta color.
Smoothed opening and closing of the Channels drawer, with steadier frame timing and gentler motion.

Improved English translations of mixed English/PT-BR stream promotions ending in 'sÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â³ vem o pai tÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¡ on' ('come join me, I'm live'), including unaccented forms. This improvement is limited to promotional endings.
Channel names in the overlay's Channels tray and Overlay settings now match their chat colors. The colors stay consistent while hovering or selecting options.
Added an optional Minimize to system tray setting. Minimizing hides the launcher behind the existing app icon while translation and the overlay keep running.
Click the tray icon to reopen the same window, or right-click for Open translator and Exit. The window's X still exits; the tray preference is saved for the next launch.
If Windows cannot create or recover the tray icon, the launcher stays accessible. Closing or updating removes the icon and finishes the existing local-service shutdown.

Protected runtime and model folders against changes by other Windows accounts while retaining the installing user's full access. Older folders with unprotected ownership records require a one-time review in Configure; parent-folder permissions are unchanged.

Runtime checks now verify the frontend and GPU libraries against the installer's trusted inventory. Known official runtimes upgrade to the protected frontend without downloading models again; unknown executable changes stop startup.
Added private credentials and connection-owner checks to both Ollama and its internal inference service. A different local process taking over a port receives no chat or reply text.
Hardened update handoff and uninstall cleanup against replaced files and redirected folders. Modified obsolete DLLs are preserved and block automatic relaunch until the conflict is resolved.
Update downloads now have a time limit covering connection setup and response headers. Startup notices use readable commands instead of encoded scripts.
Preserved devo, the nickname for Devotion Tunic and Devotion Stockings, in recognized trade messages and translated replies without expanding or translating it.
Listings such as WTS devo 10kk now show [--]. Ordinary Portuguese and Italian uses of devo remain translatable.
New installations use your per-user Windows Programs folder. Updates protect existing program files against changes by other local accounts and stop if the folder cannot be secured safely.

Configure now stops Ollama services it starts after setup or model removal, including failures. Opening the translator starts and checks the service again; failed shutdowns remain visible and can be retried.

Setup downloads can now be cancelled. Closing setup cancels its work and waits for owned-service cleanup; resumable model layers are kept. Model downloads have a two-hour limit per attempt, including connections that keep sending progress.

Future automatic updates require an independent release signature before installation, protecting against a replaced installer on the download server. Older versions need a trusted first upgrade to gain this protection. Windows may still show an unknown publisher.
Uninstall leaves unrelated services running and stops cleanup when service ownership is uncertain, even if error messages change.
Recognized universal trade listings now show [--] in the overlay instead of a guessed language. Linked items, known English item names, prices and trade shorthand are recognized locally.
Trade messages containing natural-language text keep their detected language. Clicking [--] or the sender still focuses the reply box and lets you choose a reply language.
Matched Party chat text to the bright green in the supplied in-game reference.
Added a Channels tray that slides upward from the overlay, letting you change saved chat filters without opening Settings.
Moved the resize grip to the top-right corner. Dragging it keeps the bottom-left corner anchored.
The channel tray follows the overlay, stays on-screen near the top edge, and closes when the overlay is hidden or locked.
Added selectable overlay chat channels, including Say, Party, Clan, Alliance, Whisper, Shout, Trade, World/global, Hero and Command channel.
Channel selections apply immediately to recent messages and are saved for the next launch; All and None buttons make selection easier.
Hidden channels no longer contribute to the overlay's new-message count. The launcher transcript keeps all received messages.
Added a small Discord link to the launcher and website for feedback and bug reports.
Fixed a false missing or duplicated URL error when chat mixes normal links with spaced addresses such as Kick. com /channel.
Preserved multiple and repeated web addresses, their spelling and spacing, and URL paths containing game abbreviations or prices.
Added checks for changed, missing, duplicated and reordered links in translations and replies.
Fixed ucrtbase.dll remaining after an update when the translator had loaded it.
Obsolete-file cleanup now runs independently after the translator closes and finishes before it reopens.
Added a Windows DLL-lock regression check; models, settings, and changed or unrecognized files are preserved.
Reduced the packaged DLL count from 52 to nine by using the runtime already supplied by Windows 10/11.
Updates automatically remove the 43 unchanged compatibility DLLs left by earlier versions, saving about 2.35 MB of installed files.
Isolated the build from unrelated development tools and added dependency-origin, packaged-library and upgrade-cleanup checks.
Manual and automatic updates now remove obsolete program files when they still match a previously shipped copy.
Models, settings, game files, and modified or unrecognized files are preserved; interrupted cleanup can be retried by running the installer again.
Installer builds use an exact current-file list and required license list, excluding historical installers, development data, and backup files.
Party recruitment links now show translated descriptions instead of [Linked item].
Party level ranges and player counts keep their exact text; linked item names still use the English item database.
Added checks for missing, changed, duplicated, or reordered party details, including messages containing both party and item links.
Disabled inherited Ollama request logging and extra browser origins when starting the translator's local service.
Added bounds for chat records, model responses, update records, and runtime downloads; hardened reply text and archive path handling.
Pinned localhost requests to a numeric local address and hardware checks to the Windows system executable.
Replaced unclear operational numbers with named limits and added comments explaining translation, cleanup, and update behavior.
Added an Updates control in Settings that checks for newer releases and offers Install update & restart.
Updates verify the download, stop Ollama, install the launcher, remove temporary update files, and reopen automatically.
Existing models, settings, game-folder selection, and overlay preferences are kept during updates.
Added retry messages and checks to prevent overlapping launches, installations, or uninstall operations.
Linked items now use their item IDs to find English names in an offline database of 19,199 standard items.
Fixed Chinese item titles such as Shining Knife and Sword of Solidarity staying Chinese in English chat.
Preserved enchant levels and item annotations, and fixed adjacent links leaking formatting text.
Added a structure for verified item names in other languages; unknown IDs keep their original titles.
Added the L2CT icon to the application, installer, shortcuts, and windows.
Clicking a language code or player name in the overlay activates the English reply box for immediate typing.
Removed Try a message from Settings.
Simplified reply headings to show the selected language and, for direct replies, the recipient.
Added a Starting translator progress window while Ollama starts and the selected model is checked.
Configured installations now open the translator directly, without showing setup on every launch.
Added visible shutdown progress while the dedicated Ollama service stops. The launcher stays open until cleanup finishes.
Installation now waits for model setup and verification before completion.
Uninstall removes the application and its managed models, runtime, settings, logs, and setup leftovers.
Moved game-folder selection into setup. The chat-log path can still be changed later in the launcher.
Closing the main translator now stops its dedicated Ollama service.
Improved Portuguese trade-price slang and specific Chinese equipment terms.
